title: Finiteness of the auxiliary leaf rectangles
statement: Let $X$, $Y$, and $\alpha$ be types, let $p$ be a deterministic two-party communication protocol over inputs $X$ (Alice) and $Y$ (Bob) with outputs in $\alpha$, and let $A \subseteq X$ and $B \subseteq Y$. Then the collection of leaf rectangles induced by $p$ when its reachable inputs are constrained to $A \times B$ is finite.
hypotheses_covered: p is a deterministic communication protocol over X, Y with outputs in α
A is a subset of X
B is a subset of Y
replaced:
For any protocol $p$ and constraint sets $A, B$, the collection $\texttt{leafRectanglesAux}(p, A, B)$
is a finite set.
